name: review-cockpit
description: PR Review Cockpit — a local web app that renders a review document for one pull request.

scripts.demo: npm run build && (sleep 1 && open "http://localhost:8080/?fixture=pr-fake-1" &) && python3 -m http.server -d packages/cockpit/dist 8080
scripts.lockfile:check: node -e "const l=require('./package-lock.json');const bad=Object.values(l.packages).map(p=>p.resolved).filter(r=>r&&r.includes('://')&&!r.startsWith('https://registry.npmjs.org/'));if(bad.length){console.error('package-lock.json has non-public resolved URLs:',bad.slice(0,3));process.exit(1)}"
